summary: This is a routine Form 8-K filed by Lionsgate Studios Corp. announcing the scheduling of its 2026 annual general and special meeting of shareholders for September 15, 2026, along with deadlines for shareholder proposals (July 17, 2026) and director nominations (August 14, 2026). There is no event, transaction, or corporate action such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring—only standard meeting logistics. Accordingly, this filing does not constitute a special situation and is classified as None.
